title: Typed Knowledge over Constructive Institutions
abstract: arXiv:2611.07432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Type theories designed for mathematics or program verification need only that a proposition holds; proof irrelevance in conversion erases, at the kernel level, how a claim was established. A persistent knowledge store, by contrast, must retain that record: who established a claim, by which derivation or external tool, and under which assumptions. This volume presents the theory of Eigenius---a store of typed knowledge over constructive institutions---and develops its metatheory from that requirement.   The kernel theory is a dependent type theory with cumulative universes, an impredicative universe of propositions, inductive families, and an intensional identity type. Proof irrelevance is an axiom with an explicit witness rather than a conversion rule, so proofs of a proposition are provably equal yet remain distinct terms. Definitional equality is joinability under an orthogonal rewriting system---confluent, injective on type formers,

translated_title: 构造性制度上的类型化知识
translated_abstract: 为数学或程序验证设计的类型理论只要求一个命题成立，转换中的证明无关性会在内核层面抹去该命题是如何被确立的；而一个持久化的知识存储必须保留这一记录：谁确立了该命题、通过哪种推导或外部工具、以及在哪些假设之下。本卷提出 Eigenius 的理论——一个建立在构造性制度之上的类型化知识存储——并从这一需求出发发展其元理论。其内核理论是一个依赖类型理论，具有累积宇宙、一个非直谓的命题宇宙、归纳族以及内涵相等类型。证明无关性是一条带有显式见证的公理，而非转换规则，因此一个命题的各个证明可被证明相等，却仍保持为彼此不同的项。定义相等被刻画为在一个正交重写系统——即合流的、在类型构造子上单射的……——之下的可连接性。
tldr: 该论文提出 Eigenius——一种基于构造性制度的类型化知识存储，其依赖类型理论将证明无关性作为带显式见证的公理而非转换规则，使知识存储能在“命题成立”之外保留其确立者、推导方式与假设条件等证明记录。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Eigenius, a typed knowledge store over constructive institutions whose dependent type theory treats proof irrelevance as an axiom with an explicit witness rather than a conversion rule, enabling a persistent store to retain who established a claim, by which derivation or tool, and under which assumptions.
